title: Core: AS2 ActionScript version pragma (#as3 / use namespace)
description: Test AS2 version pragmas and namespace declarations: 'use strict', 'use namespace flash.utils', 'import flash.utils.getTimer'. These may not be supported but should produce meaningful parse/compile errors rather than crashes. Also test Flash 8 import statement: 'import mx.utils.Delegate' (class import). Verify error messages are helpful.
